f < g < d2/2 in every row (tab dimensions stay inside the outer radius)
hole d follows the same coarse series as DIN 6797/6798/6796 (M10 -> 10.5, M12 -> 13, M16 -> 17, M20 -> 21, M30 -> 31)
every kept cell agreed by 3 independent clusters (torqbolt, fuller/globalfastener layout, schrauben-lexikon)
shape_hint: Thin flat round washer with a round centre hole and one rectangular tab (external nose) sticking out of the outer rim; the tab is later bent against the part or a nut flat to lock the screw, so in plan view it looks like a disc with a single lug.

role_map.g: tab dimension g as listed in all three sources (length measure of the external tab; exact definition from the standard drawing not verified)

notes: Covers only DIN 432 (external-tab / Aussennase form), 12 preferred sizes M3-M30. DIN 93 (one long tab) and DIN 463 (long tab and wing) are separate standards; DIN 463 data exist with 3 sources for d, b, L, L1, s (M4-M39) but no third source for outer diameter D, DIN 93 only 2 sources. All three DIN standards are withdrawn without successor (per hint; not verified). The tab-height h (listed in fuller/lexikon) and d3 are not published. d is the hole diameter (same series as the tooth/conical washers).

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched torqbolt (200), fuller (200), lexikon DIN_432 (200) and fasteners.eu /standards/DIN/432/ (200). 12 kept rows (M3..M30) x 5 cols (d,d2,s,f,g) x 4 pages = 240 comparisons, 240/240 equal (torqbolt==fasteners.eu on all 13 rows incl. M36). Fuller keyed by 'for thread diameter' label, lexikon keyed by hole d (3.2,4.3,...,31). M36: fuller 31, torqbolt/fe 31, lexikon 312 (obvious typo) -> only 2 agreeing clusters, correctly dropped. Sanity: d2>d, s,f,g,d,d2 non-decreasing, f<g<d2/2 for all 12.
